message.content:
The Continental Congress formally adopted the Declaration of Independence on **July 4, 1776**.  
The official signing ceremony—when the delegates affixed their signatures to the document—was held later, on **August 2, 1776**, at the Pennsylvania State House (now Independence Hall) in Philadelphia.
